verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Payouts API (square-docs-17), so payouts are a real product capability, but the pack offers only the page title. Nothing shows what the API exposes. The sales-reconciliation claim in square-docs-26 covers sales reporting, not payout composition, so it adds no credit. Missing for 10: evidence of controlling payout schedule or timing, per-payout entry breakdown of charges/fees/refunds, documented field-level detail of payout contents, independent or hands-on corroboration.
